questions.stem: $y$ is inversely proportional to $x$. When $x = 3$, $y = 12$. What is $y$ when $x = 6$?
questions.explanation: Inverse proportion means $y = \frac{k}{x}$. Since $12 = \frac{k}{3}$, we get $k = 36$. When $x = 6$: $y = \frac{36}{6} = 6$.

questions.stem: $y$ is directly proportional to $x^2$. When $x = 2$, $y = 12$. What is $y$ when $x = 5$?
It takes $4$ workers $6$ hours to complete a job. How long would it take $8$ workers at the same rate?
questions.explanation: More workers means less time (inverse proportion). Total work $= 4 \times 6 = 24$ worker-hours. With $8$ workers: $24 \div 8 = 3$ hours.
